title: 第20章 实名举报
novel_title: 栽赃陷害我？我请你们吃正义铁拳(猫饵)
content_zh: “可以聊，不过孙主任想聊什么？”林奕语气冷漠。孙洁主动求和，林奕早有心理预期。但没想到这位孙主任比他想象中更精明，连夜就打来了电话。这样既能表达诚意，又能趁事情扩大前将其化解在源头。“林书记，首先我代表我哥哥，向韩老师诚恳道歉。”孙洁态度很端正道：“另外我也知道，我哥哥的行为给韩老师造成了无法弥补的身心伤害，所以我们愿意最大限度作出赔偿，她有任何要求，我们都可以满足。”孙洁的言外之意很明确，想用经济赔偿让韩慧茹放弃追究，掩盖孙志远可能涉及的刑事犯罪。“孙主任，如果你只是想聊这些无关痛痒的话，那我们就到此为止吧！”林奕不为所动道：“我不是韩慧茹，无法代替她达成任何和解。”“我的底线是依法依规追究责任，若你哥哥没问题，自然无需畏惧组织审查。”“林书记，咱们都是体制内的人，抬头不见低头见，何必要因为一个普通人把关系闹僵？”孙洁婉言相劝，“只要你高抬贵手，大家都有台阶下，韩老师也能得到满意补偿，这不是皆大欢喜吗？”“孙主任，我必须郑重提醒你：我们都是普通人，没有高低贵贱之分。”林奕脸色一沉说道：“既然是体制中人，那就更应该带头遵法守法，这也是党员干部的底线！所以我们没什么好聊的了。如果你真心想帮你哥哥，那就劝他主动向组织投案自首吧！只要他认罪态度良好，组织会考虑从宽处理。”“林书记，你真就不能高抬贵手一次？”见林奕坚持要追究责任，孙洁终于有些不耐烦了。“我已经说的很清楚了，司法红线不容践踏！”林奕语气坚定说道：“若你哥哥有罪，就让他尽快投案自首吧！”说罢，林奕直接挂断了电话。这根本没什么可聊的，纯粹浪费时间。若是他愿意网开一面的话，梁志勇和傅彪也不会进去吃牢饭了。“郭书记，您现在有时间吗？我有事情需要向您汇报。”林奕拨通县委书记郭启平的电话，语态恭敬问候道。……“什么人啊？一点人情世故都不懂！”在林奕和郭启平通话时，县城龙庭苑小区的豪华大居室内，穿着白色性感睡衣的孙洁，愤愤不平地挂断了电话。“怎么，吃瘪了？”坐在她身边，正在喝茶看书的县委副书记兼政法委书记闫学勤，失笑问道。“哼，简直是茅坑里的石头——又臭又硬，根本没法沟通！”刚过三十的孙洁正值女人最美年华，即便是耍些小性子，也很难让人厌恶。至少对闫学勤来说，他对这个女人简直是喜欢极了。所以哪怕明知道，对方打着他的名义在诸多工程项目中捞油水，也不忍心斥责。“年纪轻轻又有背景，这种人确实不好打交道。”闫学勤放下书本，喝了口茶道：“我早就跟你说过，打电话没用。”“傅民建都在他那儿吃瘪，你一个县委办副主任，他怎么可能放在眼里？”“书记大人，他不把我放在眼里，还敢不把你放在眼里？”孙洁扔掉手机，两条雪白纤细的手臂，当即勾住了闫学勤的脖子。“跟你说过多少次，不要这么叫我！”闫学勤佯装不悦。“老色鬼，嘴上说不要，心里巴不得我这么叫吧？”孙洁太了解闫学勤了。表面上看似是正人君子，实则贪财好色、虚伪至极。这些年她暗中捞的油水，大部分都进了闫学勤的口袋。但让她欣慰的是，闫学勤对她确实很上心。若非如此，她一个仅有高中学历的前台接待，怎么可能坐到今天这种位置上。当然，有收获就有付出。闫学勤的个人占有欲极强，所以她至今还是未婚。“书记大人，这里又不是办公室，怕什么？”孙洁搂紧他的脖子，佯装楚楚可怜道：“我家里的情况你知道，就我大哥一个男丁，你得帮帮我，不然我没法跟爸妈交代啊！”“这事儿不好办啊！”闫学勤享受着她的温柔，却在正事上保持着理智，眉头紧蹙道：“那个林奕的背景深不可测，至今还没有准确说法，我要是贸然出手，只怕会激化了矛盾啊！”“哼，就算他再有背景，也得遵从上下级关系吧？你是县委副书记兼政法委书记，安云县三号人物，他不过是个乡党委书记！你要是怕了他，以后谁还把你放在眼里？”孙洁贴在他耳边，语态柔媚地蛊惑道：“书记大人，你就帮帮我嘛，今晚我也会好好帮你……”说着，她的小手就开始不老实起来。“行吧，那我让郑邦国试试，争取把你哥哥的办案权拿回县局侦办。”闫学勤倒吸一口凉气，松了口。“好，那就这么说定了，明天你就把事情给我办了。”孙洁眼眸中不禁闪过了一抹得意之色。郑邦国是安云县公安局政委，是闫学勤一手提拔的亲信，肯定会用心办好这件事。……次日上午八点，清河乡政府大院的书记办公室里。林奕看着坐在对面的韩慧茹，沉默片刻后，目光肃然凝重地确认：“韩老师，你真的确定要实名举报孙志远？”
content_en: "We can talk, but what do you want to talk about, Director Sun?" Lin Yi said indifferently.Sun Jie took the initiative to seek peace, and Lin Yi had already expected it.But he didn't expect that Director Sun was smarter than he thought and called him the same night.This can not only express sincerity, but also resolve the matter at the source before it escalates."Secretary Lin, first of all, on behalf of my brother, I sincerely apologize to Teacher Han." Sun Jie said with a correct attitude: "In addition, I also know that my brother's behavior has caused irreparable physical and mental harm to Teacher Han, so we are willing to compensate her to the maximum extent. We can meet any request she has." Sun Jie's implication is very clear. She wants to use financial compensation to make Han Huiru give up the investigation and cover up the criminal crimes that Sun Zhiyuan may be involved in."Director Sun, if you just want to talk about these irrelevant things, then let's stop here!" Lin Yi said unmoved: "I'm not Han Huiru, and I can't reach any settlement on her behalf." "My bottom line is to pursue accountability in accordance with the law and regulations. If your brother is fine, there is no need toAfraid of organizational censorship." "Secretary Lin, we are all members of the system, so why should we have a relationship with an ordinary person because of an ordinary person?" Sun Jie politely advised, "As long as you show your kindness, everyone will be able to step down, and Teacher Han will also be compensated satisfactorily.This is not the case.Are you happy?""Director Sun, I must solemnly remind you: We are all ordinary people, there is no distinction between high and low." Lin Yi said with a serious expression: "Since we are members of the system, we should take the lead in obeying the law.This is also the bottom line for party members and cadres!If you really want to help your brother, then persuade him to surrender to the organization!As long as he pleads guilty, the organization will consider giving him leniency." "Secretary Lin, can't you be so generous?" Sun Jie finally became impatient when he saw Lin Yi insisting on being held accountable."I have made it very clear that judicial red lines must not be trampled!" Lin Yi said firmly: "If your brother is guilty, let him surrender as soon as possible!" After saying that, Lin Yi hung up the phone.There's nothing to talk about, it's just a waste of time.If he was willing to be more lenient, Liang Zhiyong and Fu Biao would not go to jail."Secretary Guo, do you have time now? I have something to report to you." Lin Yi dialed the number of County Party Secretary Guo Qiping and greeted him respectfully...."Who is he? He doesn't understand the world at all!" While Lin Yi was talking to Guo Qiping on the phone, Sun Jie, who was wearing white sexy pajamas, hung up the phone angrily in a luxurious living room in Longtingyuan Community in the county town."What, are you deflated?" Yan Xueqin, deputy secretary of the county party committee and secretary of the political and legal committee, who was sitting next to her, drinking tea and reading a book, asked with a smile."Huh, it's just like a stone in a latrine - smelly and hard, and impossible to communicate with!" Sun Jie, who has just turned 30, is in the prime of life as a woman. Even if she shows some petty tempers, it is difficult for people to dislike her.At least for Yan Xueqin, he really liked this woman.So even if he knew that the other party was using his name to make money in many engineering projects, he couldn't bear to scold him."You are young and have a background. It is really difficult to deal with such people." Yan Xueqin put down his book, took a sip of tea and said, "I told you a long time ago that calling is useless." "Fu Minjian is in trouble with him, and you are a county party committee official.Deputy Director, how could he take this seriously?"Secretary, if he doesn't take me seriously, how dare he not take you seriously?"Sun Jie threw away her phone and immediately hooked her two slender white arms around Yan Xueqin's neck."How many times have I told you not to call me that!" Yan Xueqin pretended to be unhappy."Old pervert, you say no, but in your heart you wish I would call you that?" Sun Jie knew Yan Xueqin too well.On the surface he appears to be a gentleman, but in reality he is greedy for money, lustful and extremely hypocritical.Most of the money she made secretly over the years went into Yan Xueqin's pocket.But what made her happy was that Yan Xueqin really cared about her.If not, how could she, a receptionist with only a high school education, be in the position she is today.Of course, if you gain something, you have to pay.Yan Xueqin is extremely possessive, so she is still unmarried."Secretary, this is not an office. What are you afraid of?" Sun Jie hugged his neck tightly and pretended to be pitiful: "You know the situation in my family. My eldest brother is only a male. You have to help me, otherwise I can't get along with my parents.""This is not easy to handle!"Yan Xueqin enjoyed her gentleness, but kept his head on the business, and frowned: "That Lin Yi's background is unfathomable, and there is no accurate explanation yet. If I take action rashly,, I'm afraid it will intensify the conflict!" "Huh, even if he has a background, he must follow the superior-subordinate relationship, right?You are the deputy secretary of the county party committee and secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee, the third person in Anyun County, and he is just the secretary of the township party committee, so you are afraid!He, who will take you seriously in the future?" Sun Jie leaned against his ear and said softly, "Secretary, just help me, and I will help you well tonight..." As she said that, her little hands began to become dishonest."Okay, then I'll let Zheng Bangguo try and try to get your brother's case-handling rights back to the county bureau for investigation." Yan Xueqin took a breath and relaxed."Okay, then it's settled, you will take care of things for me tomorrow." Sun Jie couldn't help but have a flash of pride in her eyes.Zheng Bangguo is the political commissar of the Anyun County Public Security Bureau and a confidant promoted by Yan Xueqin. He will definitely handle this matter carefully....At eight o'clock the next morning, in the secretary's office in the Qinghe Township Government Courtyard.Lin Yi looked at Han Huiru who was sitting opposite. After a moment of silence, he confirmed with solemn eyes: "Teacher Han, are you really sure you want to report Sun Zhiyuan with your real name?"
